fixtures.preview: United go to Anfield (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney) in the relegation zone and with the manager's job in flux after Michael Carrick was sacked on 12 Nov.
talking_points: Carrick was dismissed after just three wins from 15 games in all competitions, and the club says it wants a permanent successor as quickly as possible.
Mauricio Pochettino is the reported favourite and has reportedly agreed verbally, but no appointment is confirmed, so who is in the dugout at Anfield is unclear.
United are 18th with 8 points from 10, their worst league start in 40 years, with a single league win (over Ipswich in August).
Line-ups and injuries aren't confirmed; Liverpool were 4th on 18 points in Sky's table as of 8 Nov, which wasn't re-checked.

fixtures.preview: Matchday 5 in Lisbon (8pm local, 7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney), three days after Anfield and after United's 3-2 win over Roma on 3 Nov.
Brentford visit Old Trafford at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), likely under a new manager.
A Wednesday-night trip to Tyneside at 8pm UK time (7am Thu 3 Dec Sydney); Sky says fixtures are subject to change.
Coventry visit Old Trafford at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 6 Dec Sydney).
Second-placed Sydney travel to third-placed Brisbane (6:40pm Brisbane time, 7:40pm Sydney) in a top-three clash.
talking_points: Sydney were 2nd on 7 points from 4 games and Brisbane 3rd on 7 from 3 (Wikipedia ladder, 8 Nov), behind leaders Wellington on 10.
Al Hassan Toure scored a hat-trick in the 4-1 win over Central Coast, and Gabriel Popovic scored his first goal for the club.
Patrick Kisnorbo said after that win that 'the best is yet to come'.
The squad for Brisbane isn't named yet and no injury list was found.

notes: Man Utd sacked Michael Carrick on 12 Nov; Mauricio Pochettino is reported as the favourite but no appointment was confirmed, so the Liverpool preview doesn't name a manager. Liverpool's 4th-place standing is from Sky's 8 Nov table and wasn't re-checked.

Sydney FC: ladder and results are from Wikipedia as of 8 Nov. The A-Leagues match page shows the Brisbane kick-off as TBC; 6:40pm Brisbane time comes from the A-Leagues fixture guide and matches other listings. Times for the Auckland game (no time zone given), Melbourne Victory, Perth and Macarthur were carried over from earlier club pages and not re-opened.

Man Utd fixtures after Brentford come from Sky's schedule, which says fixtures are subject to change and doesn't mark TV picks. Premier League and Nations Championship broadcasts are Stan Sport; Champions League is Stan Sport per Stan's rights deal to 2027.

Big matches: Jordan v Socceroos has no confirmed time (12:00 local is a placeholder), and the venue or date could change over player-safety concerns. Champions League kick-offs use UEFA's default times.

Local: no suburb news from the last 7 days was found apart from the e-bike story (headline only). The Redfern News site's latest stories were from October. School dates come from the Term 4 calendars and Week 5 Principal Updates (dates may change). Nothing was found for the second school or South Eveleigh (its events page returned an error).

Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union or Matildas games were found in the window. The Kings game is from Transport for NSW's event page (seen in search results only), and the Sydney FC Women and Melbourne Victory details were carried over from the club's ticket page.

Arts: gig times and venues come from Sydney Music's guide, which was only read up to 20 Nov, so later gigs may be missing. Prices are shown only where a promoter page listed them. Wolf Alice's on-sale status wasn't stated. Whispering Jack's dates and prices couldn't be confirmed (STC page blocked). Harry Potter: The Exhibition was dropped because its page blocked access.

Son and daughter: nothing confirmed for Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events, a junior parkrun, or kids' author events apart from today's State Library workshop. Sydney FC summer holiday clinics (ages 5–13) were announced without dates. The matcha workshop and parkrun details were carried over from earlier checks.

Groceries: the 11–17 Nov NSW half-price list (OzBargain) is the latest found, so these specials end on Tuesday. Next week's Woolworths and Coles lists weren't published or found, and Aldi's page showed no usable prices, so Aldi is omitted. No half-price fresh fruit, veg, eggs or wholegrain bread were listed.

Deals: BIG W's Black Friday sale starts 19 Nov. Rebel Sport's Black Friday window reportedly starts 23 Nov and Black Friday itself is 27 Nov (forecasts from guides, not confirmed by the retailers). Several earlier deals were dropped as expired or unverifiable.
Horizon was carried over and only lightly updated (expired key dates removed); entries were not re-researched this run.
